# @gertsai/shared

> Independently versioned TypeScript infrastructure packages for the gerts.ai ecosystem.

GitHub Packages is the current registry. Read access requires authentication.
Select each installed package version and public exports; repository main is
not automatically the installed release. These main URLs describe merged
sources, not unmerged changes or verified registry availability.

## Start here

- [AI consumer guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/guides/AI-CONSUMER-GUIDE.md): Version selection, safe installation, complete timeout recipe and verification boundaries.
- [Task-based file retrieval map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/guides/INDEX.md): Choose the smallest relevant guide and package contract.
- [Package catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/packages/INDEX.md): Canonical package README links grouped by task.
- [Application patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/guides/BUILDING-APPS.md): Composition patterns and repository-local references/templates requiring adaptation.
- [Reference applications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/examples/INDEX.md): Backend, hand-aligned API snapshot and web example.

## Optional

- [Consumer context template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/guides/CONSUMER-CONTEXT.md): Supply a downstream project's conventions, installed versions and verification commands without secrets.
- [Detailed installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/guides/CONSUMING-PACKAGES.ru.md): Russian registry/authentication and peer-version guidance.
- [Context7 preparation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertsai/shared/main/guides/CONTEXT7.md): Separate opt-in external indexing and acceptance; not a claim of registration.
